data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Check my bus, tracker, Service Number tab, type the service number) and names the service number as the parameter, but it adds a homepage step, a suggestion selection and a "Find my bus" click that weren't observed, and it describes the tracker step vaguely ("Choose the tracker option" instead of "Track my bus"), so it is slightly off but still automatable.
